description: Throwing range and accuracy (UAP backhand hucks)
instructions: 10 backhand hucks into a 20 m-wide lane; count how many land in. Note the distance you threw from in the notes and use the same distance each time.
10 throws past a live marker to a static receiver 10-15 m away; count completions.
Start at the middle cone, touch each line with your hand; film and time it. Alternate the first direction.
20 catches in a heads-on or overload drill; count clean catches.
